scope: Bounded social-representation audit of eight current canonical drafts, reusing retained sources and current prose. Not a full-film or community-consultation review.

inventory.assessment: Family/gender tensions are attributed to filmmaker note; rural-film readings to Palit. Sambalpuri performers are treated as workers and a distinct cultural context, not as a timeless spectacle.
inventory.perspective_limits: Selective institutional/filmmaker history; no representative account of caste, communities or audiences.

inventory.assessment: Livelihood discussion follows play/report and attributed criticism; no caste/community identity inferred from occupation. Director reception testimony remains testimony.
inventory.perspective_limits: No direct Bajnia performer account or full-film study; do not turn this introduction into a comprehensive ethnography.

inventory.assessment: Daughters-in-law and Prabha are discussed through explicitly attributed filmmaker/Alanen readings. Family warmth and restriction coexist; no claim all Odia households behave this way.
inventory.perspective_limits: Neither a women-viewer survey nor first-hand family/community testimony; original film not newly viewed.

inventory.assessment: Creative labour and collaborators are visible. Novel property conflict is separately attributed; weaver occupation not used to infer the actors’ identities.
inventory.perspective_limits: Novel summary is not a scene-by-scene adaptation analysis or comprehensive caste/gender critique.

inventory.assessment: Landlord power and worker vulnerability are situated in named fictional characters; actor and character identities kept separate. Lakshmi intervention remains visible.
inventory.perspective_limits: Brief actor profile does not fully analyse caste, sexuality or disability in Ankur. This limitation is not itself a factual misrepresentation or reason to invent unsupported identity claims.

inventory.assessment: Dowry/property pressure is a particular catalogue synopsis, not a universal rural norm. Niru is identified as a teacher with friendships as well as a prospective bride.
inventory.perspective_limits: No women’s audience reception or village ethnography; programme/critic viewpoints predominate.

inventory.assessment: Zwigato includes wife’s employment opportunities beside delivery work. Maker roots, story setting and language are distinguished; no caste/ethnic classification inferred from names.
inventory.perspective_limits: Filmmaker viewpoint and official synopsis are not worker consensus or exhaustive gender analysis.

inventory.assessment: Current body foregrounds ASHA/anganwadi and collective staff work; infrastructure/workload constraints replace generic superstition framing. Outside-Malkangiri worker interviews explicitly distinguished from residents. Programme association not film impact.
inventory.perspective_limits: Direct Malkangiri resident/Adivasi audience perspective remains unresolved. Do not characterize community assent, distrust or film response without direct evidence. Researcher/programme affiliations visible in notes.

cross_cutting_findings: No unsupported caste or ethnic identity inferred from surname, birthplace, occupation or filming/story location.
Gender and rural interpretation are tied to particular works and named sources rather than generalized community deficits.
DAMaN does not claim the real programme is a lone-doctor rescue or that health-worker testimony represents residents.
No forced praise/dissent quota is needed. Missing perspectives remain documented dependencies, not negative evidence or manufactured controversy.
next_evidence_gate: Review any direct resident account for interview identity, place, date, interviewer/production affiliation and whether it addresses the film or healthcare programme. A single account must not become community consensus.
limits: No fresh film viewing or new external search in this inventory pass.
No claim these introductory essays exhaust caste/gender/Adivasi/rural interpretation.
No canonical edits or publication authorization.
snapshot_limit: Pre-revision inventory. DAMaN subsequently enhanced with attributed criticism and resident health-access testimony; final source hash in cinema-representation-review-2026-10-25.json.
